primary_task: Build and run C/C++ (or Rust) code under AddressSanitizer to detect memory errors in tests/fuzzing and read ASan reports.

requirements.name: C compiler with ASan
requirements.check: command -v clang gcc; compiled a heap-overflow test with -fsanitize=address using both
requirements.observed: gcc: builds and ASan reports heap-buffer-overflow; clang: link fails, libclang_rt.asan-x86_64.a missing (apt-get -s install libclang-rt-18-dev resolves; archive.ubuntu.com 200)

requirements.name: linux
requirements.evidence: Linux: Full ASan support; skip when platform is Windows or macOS

requirements.name: fuzzer (libFuzzer/AFL++/cargo-fuzz/honggfuzz)
requirements.observed: not checked as hard; cargo present

notes: clang is present but its ASan runtime archive is missing, so clang -fsanitize=address fails to link; gcc ASan works end-to-end, and libclang-rt-18-dev is apt-installable.
